# Security

Tesla Valve is text, examples, and one hook. The hook runs at the start of
every session of everyone who installs the plugin and hands `AGENTS.md` to the
agent. Anything that makes it run or hand over something else is a
vulnerability, and so is a rule or an example that teaches an unsafe pattern.

Report it privately through
[GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Aquilo-Solution-S/tesla-valve/security/advisories/new),
not in an issue. Only `main` is supported.
